beats.action: Dev tries to slide his credit card under a napkin toward the waiter.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: I am sliding this card like a secret agent, Priya.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: I see everything, Dev. I have Cupertino levels of surveillance.

beats.action: Elijah leans over from the next table, looking smug.

dialogue.speaker: Elijah
dialogue.text: You need that Darnell Wright blocking energy to pay first.

dialogue.speaker: Imani
dialogue.text: Try blocking me, Elijah. I am faster than Dillon Thieneman.

beats.action: Dev looks frustrated while Wei starts writing on a napkin.

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.text: It is not a race, it is a tactical financial maneuver!

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: Statistically, splitting the bill reduces future resentment by twelve percent.

beats.action: Lin holds up her phone with a bright confirmation screen.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.text: Wei, I paid for everyone on the app five minutes ago.

dialogue.speaker: Elijah
dialogue.text: Wait, so I am just a prisoner to your generosity now?

beats.action: Wei sighs and folds his napkin neatly as Priya laughs.

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: Technically, we all owe Lin our souls and a coffee.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.text: Make it a large latte and we have a deal.

music_prompt: Upbeat, rhythmic lo-fi jazz with a snappy snare and light piano melody.
caption: When 'going Dutch' turns into a high-stakes tactical mission with the squad. 💳🏃‍♀️

history_entry.core_joke: Lin settles the entire group's bill on an app while the guys argue over who has the best defensive tackle moves to pay first.
